name: jable-desktop
description: Tampermonkey exporter and Electron desktop app for Jable favourites and watch-later lists.

scripts.rust:fmt: cargo fmt --manifest-path native/local-data-engine/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path native/download-engine/Cargo.toml -- --check
scripts.rust:check: cargo check --manifest-path native/local-data-engine/Cargo.toml && cargo check --manifest-path native/download-engine/Cargo.toml
scripts.rust:clippy: cargo clippy --manifest-path native/local-data-engine/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path native/download-engine/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.rust:test: cargo test --manifest-path native/local-data-engine/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path native/download-engine/Cargo.toml
scripts.rust:ci: npm run rust:fmt && npm run rust:check && npm run rust:clippy && npm run rust:test
scripts.build: npm run build:rust && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:renderer && npm run typecheck:electron
scripts.check: npm run rust:ci && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:renderer && npm run build:renderer
scripts.start:dev: npm run build:rust && npm run build:electron && JABLE_RENDERER_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.test: npm run build:rust && npm run build:electron && node --test test/node/*.test.js
scripts.test:electron: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.electron.config.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:unsigned: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:unsigned: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never
